subject.title: [codex] Fix Anthropic Vertex npm audit regression

question: Should maintainers close this stale conflicting branch as superseded by current main's Anthropic Vertex provider update, or sponsor a fresh local-client replacement?
rationale: The PR has protected labels and an auth-provider implementation choice that automation should not resolve; current main has also changed the central dependency shape since the previous review.

options.title: Close After Current-Main Proof
options.body: Confirm the `@anthropic-ai/vertex-sdk` 0.19.0 provider path fixes the audit/auth chain and then close this stale branch as superseded.

options.title: Sponsor Fresh Replacement
options.body: If maintainers want to remove the official Vertex SDK, open a new branch from current main with provider package, shrinkwrap, cache-policy, and live Vertex proof aligned.

options.title: Keep Parked
options.body: Leave this PR open as historical context while the linked auth issue remains under manual review.

recommendation.title: Close After Current-Main Proof
recommendation.body: Confirm the `@anthropic-ai/vertex-sdk` 0.19.0 provider path fixes the audit/auth chain and then close this stale branch as superseded.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc owns the freshest current-main provider dependency and stream-runtime state and initiated the automerge route on this PR.
